exact.新手机只有 eSIM，国内实体卡插不进去。把那张卡留在家里一台旧安卓机上，收到的: New phones are eSIM-only, so a physical SIM from back home won't fit. Leave that card in an old Android phone at home, and the SMS, calls and app notifications it receives reach the phone in your hand within seconds. Open source, self-hosted.
